title: Fever hydration and cooling watch
summary: Tracks fever, fluid intake, overheating, and danger signs during illness.
content: Fever hydration and cooling watch is a practical offline routine for illness monitoring. Record temperature if available, time, fluids, urine, sweating, confusion, rash, breathing, and neck stiffness. Move the person to a cooler shaded room and avoid excess blankets unless shivering severely. Offer safe fluids in small regular amounts only if awake and able to swallow safely. Check infants, elderly people, pregnant people, and chronic illness patients more often. Seek urgent help for confusion, seizure, severe dehydration, breathing trouble, stiff neck, or persistent worsening.
